analysis.environment: original satellite Aug-Nov nearby mean SIC
analysis.response: difference in fitted log1p nest count slopes per decade

meaning: This checks temporal association for the same count method and fixed periods; no cause attribution, no independent heldout climate transfer because beta was fitted using full 1991-2020 source sites.
caveats: Biological early/late regression slopes depend strongly on counts, and site-year support is selected by observation density.
Only 2 historical blocks; some regions contain <=2 sites, and SIC observational buffers overlap.
1991-2005 vs 2006-2020 is an exploratory time sensitivity, not a frozen hypothesis test.
Small mean historical SIC shift does not identify response to 2100 extreme future warming.
